_about: tinyagent-bench: each model's author-recommended sampling, sent identically on every request of its entries (policy 'author', the default for comparisons). Keys per model: params (temperature, top_p, top_k, min_p, presence_penalty, frequency_penalty, repetition_penalty, repeat_penalty), source (where the numbers come from), verified (true once checked against the published card). A comparison refuses a model with no entry here. Add a candidate's entry from its model card before running it.

gemma-4-E4B-it-oQ4e-mtp.source: Gemma model card recommended sampling (temperature 1.0, top_k 64, top_p 0.95), as recalled for the Gemma 3/4 family

Gemma-Wisp.source: Harbor's tuned Gemma 4 E4B (r5 step 1800): no separate author settings; uses its base model's (gemma-4-E4B-it-oQ4e-mtp)

gemma-4-E4B-it-r5-step-01800-oQ4e-mtp.source: folder name of Gemma-Wisp (same weights); same entry

anthropic/claude-haiku-5.5.source: accepts no temperature or top_p on OpenRouter (tinyagent-bench decision 2026-11-18); provider default

openai/gpt-6-luna.source: accepts no temperature or top_p on OpenRouter (tinyagent-bench decision 2026-11-18); provider default

google/gemini-4-argon.source: Google's guidance for its reasoning Gemini models: keep the defaults (temperature 1.0, top_p 0.95), as recalled for Gemini 3; unconfirmed for Gemini 4

deepseek/deepseek-v4.1-flash-1017.source: no published sampling recommendation found for this model; the provider's default decides (nothing sent)
